issues.subtopic_definition: Account hacked, stolen, disabled, banned or locked; unauthorised account changes
issues.name: Account hacked, locked, or unexpectedly logged out
issues.description: Customers report their accounts being hacked, locked out, or changed without permission, with little support available to recover them.
issues.note: Mixes genuine hacking/lockout reports with unrelated complaints such as autoplay, data collection concerns, and multi-user account switching.

issues.subtopic_definition: Cannot log in or stay logged in; forced logouts; password reset fails
issues.name: Cannot log in or stay logged in
issues.description: Customers cannot sign in or remain signed in despite correct credentials, often seeing errors or false no-connection messages.

issues.subtopic_definition: Other access/account issue not covered above (code-side default when the model returns an unlisted access subtopic)
issues.name: Other access restrictions and lyric gating
issues.description: Customers are blocked from using the app in some regions or find features like lyrics restricted in ways that limit access.
issues.note: Only two quotes, covering unrelated restrictions: regional blocking and premium-gated lyrics.

issues.subtopic_definition: Signup, email/phone verification codes, linking Facebook/Google accounts
issues.name: Signup and OTP verification failures
issues.description: Customers cannot complete signup or sign-in because phone number checks fail or verification codes never arrive.

issues.subtopic_definition: Unexpected, duplicate or post-cancellation charges, refunds, payment problems
issues.name: Unexpected charges and payment problems
issues.description: Customers are charged after cancelling, billed unexpectedly, or unable to complete payments in the app.
issues.note: Mixes post-cancellation charges, paying for ad-free while still hearing ads, and payment connection errors.

issues.subtopic_definition: Premium-only controls: forced shuffle, skip limits, can't pick songs, features moved behind the paywall
issues.name: Free tier limits basic playback controls
issues.description: Free users find core controls such as skipping, shuffle, song choice and replay restricted, feeling basic features were moved behind the paywall.

issues.subtopic_definition: Other billing issue
issues.name: Persistent upsell prompts to buy plans
issues.description: Customers are repeatedly prompted to buy subscriptions such as family plans even after turning off marketing notifications.

issues.subtopic_definition: Paid premium not activating, premium benefits missing, plan/trial not applied, cancellation difficulty
issues.name: Premium benefits missing after paying
issues.description: Customers who pay for Premium or qualify for student or trial pricing do not receive the plan benefits, or face delays and failed discount applications.
issues.note: Mixes missing premium activation, failed student discount verification, and a request for a refund.

issues.subtopic_definition: Price too high, price increases, value for money, student/family plan pricing
issues.name: Subscription price seen as too high
issues.description: Customers feel Premium costs too much and resent price increases, questioning whether it is worth the money.

issues.subtopic_definition: Platform content decisions, artist bans, political or moral objections tied to content
issues.name: Songs removed or artists censored by platform
issues.description: Customers object to Spotify removing or restricting specific artists, songs or content for political or policy reasons.
issues.note: Mixes objections to removed political content, AI music, and inappropriate songs being played.

issues.subtopic_definition: Lyrics missing, paywalled or out of sync
issues.name: Lyrics missing or not displaying
issues.description: Customers find lyrics no longer load, display out of sync, or are unavailable for certain songs.

issues.subtopic_definition: Songs, albums, artists or podcasts missing, greyed out, removed or region-locked
issues.name: Songs and albums unavailable or greyed out
issues.description: Customers find songs, albums or artists missing, greyed out as unplayable, or wrongly matched in search.
issues.note: Mixes unavailable songs with explicit-content censorship and metal genre listing bugs.

issues.subtopic_definition: Other catalog issue
issues.name: Artist not found and phantom playback
issues.description: Customers see artist-not-found errors and play prompts that appear to start but do not actually play songs.

issues.subtopic_definition: Podcast/audiobook content, video podcasts, unwanted podcast promotion
issues.name: Unwanted podcasts and limited audiobook access
issues.description: Customers cannot remove unwanted podcast suggestions or shows, and find audiobook access limited or behind a paywall.
issues.note: Mixes unwanted podcast clutter with audiobook pricing and podcast history problems.

issues.subtopic_definition: Recommendations, algorithm, repetitive suggestions, Discover Weekly, autoplay/radio picks, shuffle repeating songs
issues.name: Recommended songs replace chosen playlist tracks
issues.description: Customers find the app inserting or playing algorithm-picked songs instead of the playlists or songs they selected.

issues.subtopic_definition: Search results, finding music, browse/discovery features
issues.name: Search fails to find or misidentifies songs
issues.description: Customers cannot locate songs or artists through search, or search returns wrong results.

issues.subtopic_definition: Cannot download, downloads stuck, offline mode not working
issues.name: Downloads and offline playback fail
issues.description: Customers cannot download music or podcasts, or downloaded content fails to play without a connection.

issues.subtopic_definition: Downloaded/saved music or liked songs disappear or must be re-downloaded
issues.name: Downloaded music disappears or re-downloads
issues.description: Downloaded songs and playlists vanish, get un-downloaded, or must be re-downloaded.
issues.note: Mixes disappearing downloads with ad-looping complaints and missing album covers.

issues.subtopic_definition: Other download/offline issue (storage location, SD card, limits)
issues.name: Offline storage and SD card restrictions
issues.description: Customers cannot save downloads to SD cards, face hidden offline limits, or lose offline content after reinstalling.

issues.subtopic_definition: General criticism or 'bad app' without a specific supported topic
issues.name: General dissatisfaction with the app
issues.description: Customers express broad frustration or dislike of the app without naming a specific feature or problem.

issues.subtopic_definition: General praise without a specific praised feature
issues.name: General praise without specific feature
issues.description: Customers give broadly positive or mixed general feedback without naming a particular feature.
issues.note: Mixes genuine praise with complaints about recommendations, audio quality and ads.

issues.subtopic_definition: Unrelated, meaningless, unsupported-language, or boycott-slogan text
issues.name: Unrelated, unclear or boycott-style text
issues.description: Reviews contain emojis, hate speech, boycott slogans or unclear text that does not describe a specific product problem.
issues.note: Mixes boycott slogans, hate speech, emoji-only reviews, and some genuine but vague complaints.

issues.subtopic_definition: Sound quality, volume levels, equalizer, audio glitches
issues.name: Poor sound quality or volume problems
issues.description: Customers find audio quality weak, volume levels wrong, crossfade broken, or sound cutting out.
issues.note: Mixes genuine audio quality complaints with playback failure and lyric timing issues.

issues.subtopic_definition: 'No internet connection'/offline errors while online, failure to load or buffer
issues.name: False no-internet errors when online
issues.description: Customers see no-connection messages or buffering problems even though their device has a working internet connection.
issues.note: Mixes false no-connection errors with Bluetooth prompts and audio output problems.

issues.subtopic_definition: App crashes, freezes, won't open, black screen
issues.name: App crashes, freezes or shows blank screen
issues.description: Customers find the app closing unexpectedly, freezing, failing to open, or showing a black screen.

issues.subtopic_definition: Bluetooth, car, Android Auto, Chromecast, Connect, smart speakers, watches
issues.name: Device connection problems with speakers and cars
issues.description: Playback fails or misbehaves when connected to Bluetooth, car systems, watches, Google speakers or other external devices.

issues.subtopic_definition: Other playback issue
issues.name: Miscellaneous playback malfunctions
issues.description: Customers experience playback problems such as the app not playing songs, seek bar failures, or unexpected auto-start.
issues.note: Mixes general playback failures with seek bar bugs, library bugs, and the app turning itself on.

issues.subtopic_definition: Slow, laggy, battery drain, data or storage usage, overheating
issues.name: Slow, laggy and resource-heavy app
issues.description: Customers find the app slow to open, laggy, unresponsive or heavy on battery, data or storage.
issues.note: Mixes performance lag with auto-play switching artists and occasional update frequency complaints.

issues.subtopic_definition: Music stops, pauses, skips or jumps by itself; songs won't play
issues.name: Playback stops, skips or plays wrong songs
issues.description: Music stops, pauses, skips to different tracks, or refuses to play songs without warning.

issues.subtopic_definition: Support replies but does not solve the problem
issues.name: Support fails to resolve account problems
issues.description: Customers contact support but receive no meaningful help, slow responses, or unhelpful replies that leave issues unresolved.

issues.subtopic_definition: Too many, too long, too loud or repeated ads interrupting listening
issues.name: Too many ads interrupting listening
issues.description: Customers feel ads play too often, last too long, or repeat excessively, interrupting their music.
issues.note: Mixes ad frequency complaints with shuffle limits and playlist editing frustrations.

issues.subtopic_definition: Buttons, gestures, lockscreen/notification controls, widgets, sleep timer, settings
issues.name: Playback controls missing or unreliable
issues.description: Customers find controls such as skip, replay, shuffle, and car mode missing, unreliable, or confusingly placed.
issues.note: Mixes playback control removals with car mode toggling and settings confusion.

issues.subtopic_definition: Managing playlists, library, liked songs, queue order, sorting, editing
issues.name: Playlist and library management difficulties
issues.description: Customers struggle to organise playlists, manage liked songs, sort content, or move tracks within library views.
issues.note: Mixes playlist organisation issues with shuffle bugs and queue limitations.

issues.subtopic_definition: Other usability issue not covered above
issues.name: Miscellaneous usability and settings issues
issues.description: Customers encounter unexpected behaviour such as songs being added without warning, keyboard focus problems, or frequent updates.
issues.note: Mixes unwanted playlist additions, keyboard issues, update frequency complaints, and permission requests.

issues.subtopic_definition: Layout, redesigns, home feed, finding things, confusing navigation, design changes
issues.name: Confusing layout changes after updates
issues.description: Customers find recent redesigns hard to navigate, with key features moved or removed and slower access to content.
issues.note: Mixes layout complaints with broad update dissatisfaction and general ad timer issues.
